title: Vibrant Velvety Italian Cabbage Frittata
description: Funky, flaky, energizing Italian dish featuring Chinese leaf, simmer, jain-friendly. Perfect for a quick breakfast or brunch on-the-go.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 3 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for another minute, until fragrant.
Add the sliced mushrooms and cook until they release their moisture and start to brown, about 5 minutes.
Add the chopped spinach and cook until wilted, about 1 minute.
Add the diced tomatoes and cook for another 2 minutes, until the mixture is heated through.
In a large bowl, whisk together the vegan milk and lemon juice.
Add the shredded vegan cheese and whisk until melted.
Add the cooked vegetable mixture and stir to combine.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Pour the egg mixture into a greased 9-inch skillet or frittata pan.
Transfer the skillet to the preheated oven and bake for 25-30 minutes, until the frittata is set and golden brown.
Remove the skillet from the oven and sprinkle with chopped fresh basil.
Let the frittata cool for a few minutes before slicing and serving.
Slice the frittata into wedges and serve warm or at room temperature.
Refrigerate leftovers for up to 3 days or freeze for up to 2 months.
To reheat, thaw frozen frittata overnight in the refrigerator and reheat in the oven or microwave.
